name: EPIC 210704526
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 11.5 solar radii and 1.44 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210704526 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.51007 (16th-84th percentiles 10.785976-11.959477), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,551 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.44 solar masses and 11.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,038 K at its surface.
